session_read: Tuesday pre-open, gate AMBIGUOUS by elimination -- every term reads calm-to-positive (VIX -0.19%, ES +0.19%, NQ +0.47%, all Asia green sub-1%) except SMH -2.43%, and that print is confirmed real, not stale: Monday 8/24 was a genuine semis-led selloff (Intel -5%, AMD -3.3%, TSM -3.7%, MU -5.8% on a Netlist patent overhang, NVDA -2.3% its 7th straight down day). This morning is the bounce -- every one of 35 held names quotes UP pre-market, several +2-5% -- and smith-catalyst's read matters here: this is a sector-wide pre-earnings-week rally (SMH +14% over 4 sessions), not fresh idiosyncratic news, so don't overread the green. 11 real trades executed overnight, all reconciled to email confirmations by smith-ledger (35/35 lots, zero mismatches): five new/re-entered positions (KLAC -- brand new, COHR and NBIS re-entries, NVDA and SKHY re-entries) and six adds (MRVL, MU, GOOG, CIEN, ASML, AMAT). Cash is now thin -- $3,499 total, $1,433 deployable above the policy floor -- which bound today's sizing hard: the AMZN conviction-average add alone consumed 83% of what was available, crowding out live GLW/TER/WDC candidates on cash-priority grounds, not evidentiary ones. Binary earnings risk is heavy this week -- NVDA tomorrow, MRVL Thursday, AVGO and CIEN next week, 13.91% of the book at risk within 9 sessions -- and AVGO/CIEN both carry a genuine 'beat and fall' pattern worth remembering before reading either as a clean dip-buy: four straight EPS beats each, but their last two prints closed roughly -13% same-day anyway. CIEN is already -6.02% into its 9/3 print. A real correction from tonight's tax pass: all four open trim/sell proposals (AVGO, BX, MSFT, AMD) realize losses on a cost-basis view, not profit -- their rationale text describing '1-month momentum vs SMH' as profit-taking was never checking against actual lot basis, and every one of those lots was bought in August above today's price. Fixed in how they're framed here. AMZN's own conviction-average add auto-retired under the 3x-restatement rule -- genuinely proposed 08-19, 08-24 and again this morning and never acted on, not a testing artifact, so it's shown as retired rather than revived.
